claim_tested: The exposed C-terminal Gly is the PE acceptor; Atg7 E1 and Atg3 E2 are required

confidence_limitations: high; defines the enzyme set that was then checked in N. crassa

key_finding: Atg8-Atg19 and LC3-p62 structures; 15 Atg8 residues contact the WEEL peptide, defining HP1 and HP2
